title: On the Limitations of Reference-Free Evaluations of Generated Text

bias_targets.methodology: Applying approximate inference algorithms (direct optimization, greedy extraction, and reranking) to maximize the scores of reference-free metrics (Prism-src, COMET-QE, QuestEval), and comparing these scores against human-written references to demonstrate that the metrics systematically favor model-generated text (especially from models similar to their own underlying models) over higher-quality human-written text.
